note: Validated request presets for the demo. They contain no products, prices, merchants, stock or delivery claims. Dates are offsets from when the example is loaded.

scenarios.title: Restock wood glue
scenarios.purpose: We're running low on wood glue for our wooden kitchen-accessory production line. We need 128 US fluid ounces total, new and unopened, within a $100 total budget. It needs to arrive within seven days. It must be suitable for interior hardwood assembly. A smaller number of containers would be a bonus.
mandatory: Explicit suitability for interior hardwood assembly

scenarios.title: Monitors for four incoming interns
scenarios.purpose: We just signed a new client and have four interns starting soon. We need four new monitors, each at least 27 inches, with at least 2560 × 1440 resolution and HDMI. Our total budget is $1,000. They need to arrive within ten days. Height-adjustable stands would be a bonus.

scenarios.title: Urgent replacement café blender
scenarios.purpose: Our café's blender broke, and smoothie orders are backing up. We need one new countertop blender with at least a 64-US-fluid-ounce pitcher, explicitly listed for commercial use, within a $300 total budget. It must arrive within three days.
mandatory: At least 64 US fluid ounces pitcher capacity

scenarios.title: Portable power for community outreach
scenarios.purpose: We're running an outdoor community food-distribution event in eight days, but the venue has no outlets. We need one new portable power station with at least 500 Wh capacity and two AC outlets, within a $500 total budget. It must arrive within seven days so we can check it before the event. Lower weight would be a bonus.
